data_quality.title: Holding counts aren't reliable yet
data_quality.text: In a 1,000-teacher sample (Sep 24), only 3.5% of Holding teachers had an Orientation Complete Month and none had a First IJ Activity date, while 63% had logged in. Gainsight appears to place anyone it can't classify into Holding, including returning teachers who are using Inquiry Journeys. The Holding flow is paused and the question is with Jenn (RevOps). Treat the Holding and Eligible totals as upper bounds until the Gainsight logic is fixed.
